IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black
hair falls past her shoulders and wears layered
silver necklaces. She wears a lilac long-sleeve
mesh top with a scoop neckline, a sheer
lace-trimmed bodice, and a center zip, over dark
flare jeans with a wide embellished metal belt. Her
hands rest at her hips, and her expression is calm.
Soft, even studio light against a plain white
backdrop. Palette of lilac, charcoal denim, and
silver. Delicate and playful, in the style of a Y2K
lookbook.
